ww.h0: Two routes: Grundsicherungsgeld or housing benefit (Wohngeld)
ww.a.t0: Covers your whole need: standard rate, rent and heating, plus health insurance. In return there are duties: documents, appointments and looking for work.
ww.b.t0: A top-up to your own income, without duties at the Jobcenter.
ww.regel0: If Wohngeld together with your income covers your need, it comes first. If not, you get Grundsicherungsgeld.
gn.liste: For a more precise result, still missing: {liste}.
gn.brutto: gross pay (at the top of your payslip)
f.auf.1.fuer: Each of these benefits has its own cover letter: {liste}.
f.auf.1.form: For {liste} there is an official form (step 2). You don't need a cover letter for it.
bp.scan.p: Scan the decision letter. SoLo recalculates it and shows differences.
bp.jc.was: SoLo recalculates the amounts in your decision for one month, with the same rules as the benefits check: standard rates, additional needs, rent and heating, and the income counted. Where the decision differs to your disadvantage, SoLo shows the difference and the reason.
bp.wid.fehlt: Still missing: {liste}. That is why the objection has no reasons with figures yet. It still meets the deadline. You send the reasons later.
bp.wid.keinGrund: SoLo found no reason. That is why the objection has no reasons yet.
bp.wid.bis.t: By this day the objection must reach the office that sent the decision. Calculated: date of the decision plus 4 days for the post, then one month. If the letter arrived later, the deadline can end later.
bp.art.frage: What kind of letter is it?
bp.art.anh: Hearing (Anhörung – the office asks before it decides)
bp.art.anh.t: A hearing is not yet a decision. Briefly explain what happened and add proof. You can only object to the decision that follows.
bp.art.termin.tag: When is the appointment? (it is in the letter)
bp.datum: Date of the decision (top right of the letter)
bp.datum.t: Enter the date. SoLo then shows right away by when you can object.
